<function name="DoRightClick" parent="DLabel" type="panelhook">
	<description>
Called when the label is right clicked (on key release) by the player.

This will be called after <page>DLabel:OnDepressed</page> and <page>DLabel:OnReleased</page>.

See also <page>DLabel:DoClick</page>, <page>DLabel:DoMiddleClick</page> and <page>DLabel:DoDoubleClick</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creates a label in the center of the screen, that prints `I was right clicked!` to the console and disappears when right clicked.</description>
	<code>
local lbl = vgui.Create( "DLabel" )
lbl:SetFont( "DermaLarge" )
lbl:SetText( "Click me!" )
lbl:SizeToContents()
lbl:Center()
lbl:SetMouseInputEnabled( true )
function lbl:DoRightClick()
	print("I was right clicked!")
	self:Remove()
end
	</code>
	<output>
```
I was clicked!
```
 When the label is right clicked.</output>
</example>
